note: Every guide below is written for this entry, in our own words. Each names the guides it drew on; the official names and descriptions are shown as PlayStation publishes them.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you earn, not a task of its own: it pops the moment the other 54 are all done. Work the roadmap in order, clear the missables before their last chances pass, and leave the long grinds (stunts, WAiNK, vehicles) for the cleanup stage so nothing is left but counting. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy guide.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing through to its end. It is the game's first mission, so it unlocks in normal story play with nothing to prepare and nothing to miss — just follow the on-screen objectives until the mission-complete screen. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies unlock automatically at the chapter's end, so the only way to delay this one is to leave a mission unfinished; side activities can wait. Before the chapter closes, do the Chapter 1-only tasks in the Missables tab — the meditation spot on Lucia's balcony is the one players argue about. Sources: PSNProfiles trophy guide; GTA Wiki — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it pops at the chapter's end with no extra requirement, so keep pushing the story and use the free-roam gaps between missions for collectibles that sit nearby rather than backtracking later. Sources: Exophase trophy list; IGN GTA 6 Wiki.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. By now Vice City itself is open for the longer grinds — drone races, stunts and vehicle discovery — so it is worth clearing a few of those between missions instead of leaving all of them for the post-game cleanup. Sources: PSNProfiles trophy guide; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, so before you start the final mission, check the Missables tab and finish anything whose last chance is tied to the story ending — the finale locks off earlier moments. Sources: Exophase trophy list; TrueTrophies GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Play the final story mission to its end. It is a gold trophy because it closes the story, not because it is hard — there is no special requirement beyond completing it. Make a manual save before starting it, in case you want to replay the ending or mop up anything the finale changes. Sources: PSNProfiles trophy guide; GTA Wiki — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in Chapter 1. Mission trophies like this one unlock on completion, so there is no side objective to worry about — follow the mission, and the trophy follows. Sources: Exophase trophy list; Game8 GTA 6 walkthrough.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions tend to have a setup phase first, so finish any setup the game asks for and then run the heist itself; the trophy pops when the mission completes. Sources: PSNProfiles trophy guide; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It unlocks on completion like the other mission trophies, so play it through and do not worry about optional objectives — they are not part of this trophy. Sources: Exophase trophy list; IGN GTA 6 Wiki.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. The name is a hint at the mission's tone, but the requirement is plain: finish the mission. If you fail a section, the game lets you retry from a checkpoint, so a failed attempt costs nothing. Sources: PSNProfiles trophy guide; TrueTrophies GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, the airport mission. Expect a vehicle section around the airport grounds; keep moving and use cover between objectives, and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen. Sources: Exophase trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Despite the name, the requirement is just mission completion — finish it and the trophy is yours. It sits late in the story, so pair it with the Chapter 4 cleanup pass before moving on to the finale. Sources: PSNProfiles trophy guide; Game8 GTA 6 walkthrough.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist. That checklist is the sum of the story, the stranger strands, the collectibles and the activities in this guide — so this trophy is really a progress meter for everything else. Check the in-game stats page regularly; if it stalls below 100%, the gap is usually a collectible set or a stranger strand, not the story. Do the missables first, because a missed one-time task is the only thing that can force a second playthrough. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; PSNProfiles trophy guide.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, long airtime and the like — across Leonida. The counter is cumulative and never resets, so the fastest route is to fold stunts into normal driving: take jumps, thread traffic and use the ramps and hills you pass anyway. The in-game stats page shows the running total, so check it during the cleanup stage and grind the remainder at a jump you can repeat quickly. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy guide.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type in the game at least once. The game counts nine types — the races, the shooting range, fishing, the arcade, bowling, drone races, the gym-style and bar activities and the rest of the leisure map — so open the activities list in the pause menu and tick them off one by one. One attempt each is enough; you do not need to win or finish any of them for this trophy. Sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; GTA Wiki — GTA VI activities.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge has its own gold score, shown before you start it, so treat them one at a time: learn the target pattern on a first run, then go for score. Use the range's own weapon for each challenge rather than your loadout, take the slow, aimed shots first to bank points, and replay any challenge freely — nothing here is one-time. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy guide; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is its own race, so you need a win at each one, not 14 wins anywhere. Learn a course's gates on a first attempt, then race it properly; the drone handles the same everywhere, so the skill that transfers is cutting corners through gates instead of flying wide. The map marks each location once you have found it. Sources: PSNProfiles trophy guide; IGN GTA 6 Wiki.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — 20 distinct race events, not the same race 20 times. Work through the race list across Leonida in any vehicle class you are comfortable with, and keep a note of which ones you have won; the tracker in this guide helps. Short circuit races are the quickest wins, and a win counts even on the easiest difficulty. Sources: Exophase trophy list; TrueTrophies GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.lastChance: While Cal's fishing challenge is offered — do it the first time it appears
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge: out-fish him in the head-to-head the game offers. Fish steadily rather than reeling hard the whole time, watch the line tension, and land the bigger catch. Treat this as possibly missable — do it the first time the challenge is offered rather than assuming it comes back. Sources: PSNProfiles trophy guide; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.dispute: Sources differ: some guides list Cal's challenge as replayable in free roam, others as a one-time story-adjacent event. Our call: do it at the first offer; both versions agree it can be done then.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — any cabinet, any game, to its end. Pick the shortest cabinet you find, learn its one mechanic in a minute, and finish a full run. You do not need a high score or a perfect run, just a completed game. Sources: Exophase trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI activities.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to his final mission. Side-character strands unlock as the story advances, so check the map for Andy's marker between story missions and clear his jobs as they appear rather than leaving the whole strand for the end. Sources: PSNProfiles trophy guide; IGN GTA 6 Wiki.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to his final mission. Like Andy's strand, Kenton's jobs appear over the course of the story — do them when they show up so the finale is waiting for you instead of a backlog. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to his final mission. Billy's strand is bike-flavoured, so keep a decent bike handy when his markers appear and clear his missions in order — each one unlocks the next. Sources: PSNProfiles trophy guide; GTA Wiki — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as question-mark markers on the map; each strand is several missions long, so this is a silver for persistence, not difficulty. Start strands as soon as they appear and work them between story chapters — the eight you need include the Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret strands in this guide, plus two more strangers you meet while exploring. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; PSNProfiles trophy guide.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to his final mission. Randy's jobs revolve around supply runs, so keep a fast, sturdy vehicle ready when his marker appears and clear his missions in order as the story opens them up. Sources: PSNProfiles trophy guide; Game8 GTA 6 walkthrough.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to his final mission. Tyrone's strand opens mid-story; answer his calls and clear his missions as they appear so the strand is finished before the final chapter, when side content gets harder to reach. Sources: Exophase trophy list; IGN GTA 6 Wiki.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.lastChance: Chapter 1 — before Tourist Trap (the balcony spot)
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida — 18 spots in total, one session at each. The first is the morning balcony session at Jason's house in Chapter 1: accept it when it is offered, because that spot only exists in Chapter 1. After that, work the open-world spots in free roam — beaches, swamps, mountain tops and parks — using the map markers, and tick each off in this guide's tracker so you can see which of the 18 are left. Sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide; PSNProfiles trophy guide; GTA Wiki — GTA VI meditation spots.

sources.name: GTA Wiki — GTA VI meditation spots

trophies.dispute: Sources differ: does the Chapter 1 balcony session count toward the 18? Some guides count it as one of the 18; others say the trophy still unlocks without it. Our call: do it in Chapter 1 either way — both versions agree that is safe.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret's strand points you at a specific animal in a specific area — follow his directions, track it quietly, and take the shot cleanly rather than scaring it off. If the hunt fails, the animal can be tried again, so a missed shot costs time, not the trophy. Sources: PSNProfiles trophy guide; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — shops, interiors and out-of-the-way spots — and each set needs every card in it, so collect in sets rather than at random and trade duplicates if the game allows it. Use the in-game collection screen to see which cards of a set you still lack, and finish the three easiest sets first. Sources: Exophase trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI collectible cards.

sources.name: GTA Wiki — GTA VI collectible cards

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. WAiNK It is the in-game photo-sharing action, so the grind is really a tour of Leonida: stop at landmarks, viewpoints and odd corners, snap the shot, and move on. The counter tracks distinct locations, so revisiting the same spot adds nothing — keep moving to new places and let the vehicle-discovery and exploration trophies progress alongside it. Sources: PSNProfiles trophy guide; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge list. Challenges cover driving, combat, exploration and leisure, and most complete themselves as you play the rest of this guide — so check the challenge menu early, note the easy ones (a distance driven, a number of photos, a few stunts), and deliberately clear those during the cleanup stage until the counter hits 50. Sources: Exophase trophy list; TrueTrophies GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Do it in open country where you can outrun the police: raise the heat away from town, then break line of sight, switch vehicles if you can, and stay out of the search area until the stars clear. It is easier with a fast car and a head start than in the middle of Vice City. Sources: PSNProfiles trophy guide; IGN GTA 6 Wiki.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner, keeping your wanted level the whole time — the streak breaks if the heat drops. Plan a route past three close shops, hit them fast one after another, and keep moving between them so the police never catch up and clear the stars. A quick vehicle parked outside each shop matters more than the loot. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. A vehicle counts when you first get in or drive it, so variety is everything: take every new car, bike, boat and truck you see, even for a few seconds, and visit different districts because each area spawns different traffic. Parking lots, dealerships and the docks are the fastest places to find models you have not driven yet. Sources: PSNProfiles trophy guide; GTA Wiki — GTA VI vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies group together — a gang hideout or a police-heavy escape — then trigger Combat Focus with a full weapon and work through the group without letting the effect end. A weapon with a large magazine helps, and the trophy counts downs, not kills, so keep firing until the fifth drops. Sources: Exophase trophy list; IGN GTA 6 Wiki.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave the airport (VCIA) in a way the schedule never planned — take a plane and go. Get airside, get into a plane on the tarmac, and take off without waiting for any flight. The runways are the obvious place to try it; expect a wanted level the moment you do, so be ready to fly straight out over the water. Sources: PSNProfiles trophy guide; GTA Wiki — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: This one is about the Rhino tanks — the trophy's wording is a joke, and the requirement is tied to getting into, or dealing with, a Rhino. The practical route is to reach a wanted level high enough that the military responds, then take a Rhino for a drive. Sources: PSNProfiles trophy guide; TrueTrophies GTA VI trophy guide.
trophies.dispute: Sources differ: some guides say the trigger is driving a Rhino, others say surviving in one under fire. Our call: get into a Rhino at a high wanted level and keep it moving — that satisfies both readings.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: move slowly, stay out of the staff's line of sight, take the goods and leave before any alarm. Save the game first — if you are spotted, reload the save and try again rather than fighting your way out, since a clean run is the whole requirement. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Each vault is a job of its own — get in, take the money, and get clear of the wanted level before it counts. Plan the escape before the entry: a fast car parked close, a route out of town, and no lingering at the scene. Five clean escapes, not five attempts, is the count. Sources: PSNProfiles trophy guide; IGN GTA 6 Wiki.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida — find one on the road, stop it, take the cash from the back, and lose the wanted level that follows. A heavy vehicle to block it with, or explosives to crack it open, both work; the escape afterwards is what the trophy checks. Sources: Exophase trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every area of Leonida until the whole map is revealed. Drive, fly and sail through each region rather than fast-travelling past it — the game counts an area once you have been through it. The map screen shows which regions are still blank; clear the islands, the swamps and the northern parks last, since those are the ones players leave for the end. Sources: PSNProfiles trophy guide; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Illegal operations are marked on the map once you find them, and each gang runs its own — so work through the gang list one by one, hitting a different gang's operation each time. Keep a checklist of which gangs you have done; the last one is easy to forget. Sources: Exophase trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a bar with a view on Ocean Beach. Walk into a beachfront bar on Ocean Drive, order a drink, and enjoy the view — the trophy is a small moment, not a challenge, and it pops once the drink is served. Do it in the evening for the best view, and pair it with the WAiNK It tour since you are on the beach anyway. Sources: PSNProfiles trophy guide; IGN GTA 6 Wiki.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a vehicle straight out through the glass of a vehicle showroom, in the classic style. Pick a showroom with a big front window, get a car inside or line one up outside, and smash out through the glass at speed. The trophy is about the exit, so do not stop to browse — go in, turn around, and leave through the window. Sources: Exophase trophy list; TrueTrophies GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — play a game there to its end. The alley is the one the trophy names, so go to that venue specifically rather than any other leisure spot, pick up a ball, and finish the game. It also counts toward trying every activity type. Sources: PSNProfiles trophy guide; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This trophy is about the partnership between the two leads reaching a moment the public notices — a mass-appeal moment in the story. It unlocks through story play tied to Lucia and Jason working together, so keep playing the story and it will come; there is no separate task to grind for it. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PSNProfiles trophy guide.
trophies.dispute: Sources differ: the official description is deliberately vague, and guides disagree on which story beat triggers it. Our call: it is story-tied, so no action is needed beyond playing through; we do not invent a specific mission for it.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.lastChance: Choices lock in as you make them — there is no undo
trophies.guide: Make choices across the story — the trophy tracks the decisions you take, for better or worse. There is no single right answer: play the story, take the choices the game offers, and the trophy comes as the count builds. Because a choice cannot be unmade, do not rush past decision moments; if you want a particular outcome, save before the choice so you can see both sides. Sources: PSNProfiles trophy guide; TrueTrophies GTA VI trophy guide.
trophies.dispute: Sources differ on whether choices made as either lead count, or only one of them. Our call: make choices with both characters whenever the game offers them, which satisfies both readings.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second attempt — the trophy is about the retry, not the first try. The natural way it pops is to fail something (a mission, a challenge, a stunt) and then succeed at the very next attempt, so do not be surprised if it arrives while you are retrying other trophies. If it has not popped by the cleanup stage, deliberately fail and retry a short challenge. Sources: Exophase trophy list; GTA Wiki — GTA VI trophies.
trophies.dispute: Sources differ on what counts as the 'second time' — a mission retry, or a second attempt at any activity. Our call: a failed-then-passed retry of any single task, which is the reading every guide agrees can trigger it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange in Leonida — one of the game's odd, out-of-the-way events. These moments hide in remote places and at odd hours, so explore the map's edges, visit the swamps and the northern wilderness at night, and pay attention to anything that does not fit. It pops the moment the event plays out, so keep exploring until it does. Sources: PSNProfiles trophy guide; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
trophies.dispute: Sources differ on which strange event triggers it — guides name different locations. Our call: it is tied to witnessing a strange event, not one fixed spot, so explore widely rather than camping one place.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and bowl them over. Find a slow stretch of road with pedestrians, drive past at low speed, and swing as you pass. It takes timing more than speed, so go slow, aim for a lone pedestrian, and retry until the hit connects. Sources: Exophase trophy list; IGN GTA 6 Wiki.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists, so the money flows in as you work the robbery trophies — then move it through your contacts a little at a time instead of holding it. The counter is cumulative across the whole game, so by the cleanup stage the bank jobs alone should have brought in most of it. Sources: PSNProfiles trophy guide; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Every purchase counts — clothes, weapons, food, car mods — so buy what you actually use and the total climbs on its own. By the cleanup stage, if it has not popped, spend the remainder on the most expensive useful things: vehicle upgrades and properties give the best value per dollar. Sources: Exophase trophy list; TrueTrophies GTA VI trophy guide.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property in Leonida. Garages appear on the map as purchasable properties once you have the money — visit each one, buy it, and move to the next. They double as storage for the vehicles you need for the discovery trophy, so buy them as you find them during the exploration stage rather than all at once at the end. Sources: PSNProfiles trophy guide; GTA Wiki — GTA VI properties.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find ten different vehicles, open the Scooter Bros app on the in-game phone, and register each one. Any vehicle you drive counts, so register the new models you discover for the vehicle trophy as you go — the two trophies progress together. Sources: Exophase trophy list; PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide.
